title: Hub: authorize the Removes the did_webvh rules require without canRemoveOwnClient
description: Follow-up to decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.25 reading (b). Today a revocation Commit's Remove of the user's own revoked device needs canRemoveOwnClient in room policy; mimid-agent's default member role now has it, but rooms made before, or by other clients, may not. The Observer could report which Removes the rules required (leaf's SCID = committer's SCID, key not in the record the same Commit sets), and hub/policy.rs could authorize those without a capability. Needs a decision bead on whether room policy may be bypassed for this.
notes:
Decided by Mark 2026-11-17: always allow. The hub authorizes Removes the did_webvh rules require (leaf SCID = committer SCID, key absent from the record the same Commit sets) regardless of room policy. To build.
2026-11-18, bead mimid-1wgh.4.81.34: required_removes now keys on the Commit carrying an AppDataUpdate of the record component instead of a GroupContextExtensions proposal; the rule is otherwise unchanged. The 'not covered' case (another member commits the revocation) was closed by decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.31.
close_reason: 236542a: decision (Mark 2026-11-17, always allow) built narrowly. Observer reports CommitDetail::did_webvh_required_removes = Removes of leaves whose SCID is the committer's and whose key is absent from the did_webvh record the same Commit sets (Commit must carry a GroupContextExtensions proposal; member committers only; computed only while enforce_did_webvh). hub/policy.rs skips the capability check for exactly those leaf indices; every other Remove and everything else in the Commit still goes through room policy. Decision note in hub/policy.rs authorize_commit. Tests: hub_didwebvh.rs (room role lacks canRemoveOwnClient: revocation accepted; own device still in record refused as RemoveOwnClient; revocation + alice's leaf refused as Kick; mutation check: accept test fails with the set emptied), hub_policy.rs two cases. Not covered by this rule: a revocation committed by another member (Update proposal by reference), whose Remove is still a kick. Feedback item 25 updated.
